# 🏗️ COSC3306 Final Course Project – Interactive 3D Architecture Environment

## 📘 Overview
This repository contains the **Final Project** for **COSC3306** — *Interactive 3D Architecture Environment*.  
The project demonstrates 3D modeling, lighting, camera controls, animation, and interactivity using **Three.js**.

Students are required to build a **two-room virtual apartment** featuring textures, furniture, lighting, and smooth camera navigation.

---

## 🧱 Project Requirements
Based on the official project description:

### 1️⃣ Structure
- Build a complete 3D architecture with **two or more distinct rooms**.  
- Include **walls, floors, ceilings**, and **doorways/openings** between rooms.  
- Use geometric primitives or custom geometries to shape your scene.

### 2️⃣ Room Details & Furnishings
- Each room must include **3–5 furniture objects**.  
- Use at least **three different materials** with realistic properties (e.g., wood, metal, fabric).  
- Scale and position all objects accurately.

### 3️⃣ Camera Navigation
- Implement smooth camera control across all rooms.  
- Use `OrbitControls` or a custom camera system.  
- (Bonus) Add camera transitions or collision detection.

### 4️⃣ Animation
- Add at least **one animated or interactive object** such as a rotating fan or opening door.

---

## 💡 Deliverables
As required by the course rubric:

| Deliverable | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| 🧩 **Source Code** | Runnable project files (`.html`, `.js`, `.css`) using Three.js |
| 📄 **Written Report (3–5 pages)** | Contains run instructions, implemented features, asset list, known issues, and screenshots |
| 🧠 **Peer Evaluation Form** | Required for group submissions |
| 🎥 **Visual Demo** | Screenshots or a short recording showing camera views and animations |
